feature_notes.resources.bulk_update: Added in API version 2.4.0 via PATCH /v1/resources/bulk.
feature_notes.reports.basic: Requires the reports:read scope. See authentication.md.
feature_notes.reservations.waitlist: Added in API version 2.5.0 via POST /v1/reservations/waitlist. Available on Growth and Enterprise plans.
feature_notes.billing.invoices: Added in API version 2.5.0. Requires the billing:manage scope, gated to the owner or billing_admin roles. GET /v1/enterprises/{id}/billing/invoices.
feature_notes.sso.saml: Enterprise plan only; configured separately in the account dashboard, not via the Connector API.
